build_word.subtitle: Lead Skazz out of the woods!

pick_word.subtitle: Find signs leading out of the woods!

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which guy did you like the most?
Have you ever had a summer fling?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey! What's going on here?!
Skazz runs up to Mallika and Spike.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm just having a little talk with Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Well, you'd better stop because she's `my` hot date!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you'd better stop because she's [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] hot date!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Gee, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look man, don't flip out! We were just chatting...
Spike shoots Mallika a quick knowing look and then skates off.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Now then... You wanna go grab a slice of pizza?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah, okay...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's good to know... But what's the worst that could happen?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: He once took a date to the movies, and the projector caught on fire. Another time he went to the beach, and the girl got stung by a jellyfish.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And the last date he went on... Let's just say it gave a whole new meaning to 'food poisoning'!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, I appreciate the heads up... But I promised my friend I'd keep an open mind, and I'd like to stick to that!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, you can keep your mind as open as you want... I'm more worried about your body!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That, uh, didn't come out right.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'll let it slide, just this once. Skazz mentioned a walk down to the lake, and I know that area pretty well. I'm not worried!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You're pretty brave... I know my way around the woods too, but you couldn't pay me to go down there alone with Skazz!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm Spike, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Nice to meet you, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, I'm just trying to help out!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I've got no real reason to listen to you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: My friend Nicole set me up on this date, and I trust her judgment!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Really? You trust `Nicole's` judgment? You're saying she's never made a bad call?
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? You trust [color=#e23b3b][i]Nicole's[/i][/color] judgment? You're saying she's never made a bad call?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well...
Mallika thinks back to earlier that year...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You want to sneak into this yacht party disguised as pirates? Are you sure this is a good idea?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Of course! What's the worst thing that could happen?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, so she's made a bad call now and again. But just because she got us banned from the Centerscore Yacht Club doesn't mean she can't be trusted!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: All right, whatever. Just trying to help you out. When you wake up tomorrow morning in the emergency room, don't say Spike didn't warn you!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: So, I don't know what you wanted to do tonight, but I was thinking maybe we could grab some dinner and go for a walk down to the lake...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: My buddy told me about this one place with a great view!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sure, that sounds fine... Say, how do you know Nicole, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh, I know her brother... I met him when I was doing my community service for some stupid shoplifting charge...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'm gonna go grab my skateboard... Wait right here!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: This is going to be awesome!
Skazz runs off.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Grr... This is Nicole's idea of a good summer fling? I'm going to kill that girl!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I mean... Open-minded... Open-minded... Just because he's not Phil doesn't mean I won't have fun...
From across the skate park, Mallika hears Skazz's voice...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Aw, man! I spilled orange juice all over my skateboard! Now I gotta go clean it off!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Pssst! Over here!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, you! What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You go to Centerscore, right? Your name's Mallika?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah, that's me. Do I know you?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Naw, we haven't really met. Listen, you seem like a nice girl, so I thought I'd give you a heads up...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You really don't want to go on this date.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Trust me, I know Skazz, and there's a reason girls never go on a second date with him.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It doesn't matter where he takes you... Something is going to go horribly wrong. It's like his curse.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey! I don't need your pity!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh! I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I mean, that's life, right? You make your choices, and then you gotta live with the consequences!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess...?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Besides, it wasn't all that bad. I got some sweet free karate lessons out of it! Hai-ya!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: They, uh, call that move 'The Stumbling Eagle'.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sure they do...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I know, right? That's what I'm saying! What kind of a loser has to go online and pretend to be someone else?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: When I'm typing as `SuperBuffStud123`, I'm just being myself!
nodes.text_bbcode: When I'm typing as [color=#e23b3b][i]SuperBuffStud123[/i][/color], I'm just being myself!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... Right.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I mean, I guess it is hard when people don't turn out to be what you expected.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I know a lot about that.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah! Exactly! You know, I really feel like we understand each other!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: More than you realize, I think.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Look, I appreciate you trying to help. I really do. But I'm just not ready for anything like that right now.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Fine, fine. I'll lay off. But promise me one thing... If something comes up, you'll be open-minded, okay?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Fine. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now will you take a look at my poem?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sigh...
The next day, Mallika is heading to the mall to buy some music when...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: A text message! Let's see here...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: 'Meet me at the Centerscore Skate Park. Urgent. Your BFF, Nicole.'

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: The skate park? I wonder what she's doing there!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hmm... I don't see any sign of Nicole...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Come on, dude, that was totally a triple kickflip!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? Is that a joke? Because you can't be serious...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Dude, what do you call what I did right before I fell down?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: 'Flailing and screaming'?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um, excuse me? Have either of you seen a girl named Nicole?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh! So `you're` my date?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! So [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] my date?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Nicole told me I'd be meeting a girl here for a blind date!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Grr! She set me up!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Remember what you promised... Be open-minded...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh, I mean... She set me up... With a cute date! So, hi!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What's up, foxy times? I'm Skazz.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm Mallika. Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, I'm out of here. You two have fun.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: So... Nicole told me you just got out of a long relationship, huh?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, did she?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: It's cool, I totally understand. I just got out of a long relationship too.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: It was this girl I met on a skateboarding website... We dated over the Internet for three months...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Then I went to visit her, and she turned out to be a 37-year-old karate instructor... And a dude!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh! That's... Um...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You mean... Just like Phil?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, what am I supposed to say? That I want someone dumb and mean, preferably with a unibrow? It's not my fault Phil was perfect!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey! What did I say about that kind of talk?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Believe me, Phil was far from perfect. Okay, so maybe he had perfect teeth and perfect hair and that killer body and a great sense of humor...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But you know what? I bet he wasn't a very good kisser!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: He was wonderful...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: All right, so that might not have been the best example. But the point is, Phil stinks, and you could do way better than him.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Come on, there's got to be something about Phil you didn't like!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well... I guess sometimes it was annoying how much he talked about basketball...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That's it! Perfect! You couldn't stand that he was another boring, bland, meathead jock with no personality!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's not what I said...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And you're looking for a good time with a rugged, dangerous, bad boy!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Where are you getting this?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't you worry about a thing, Mallika. I know just the guy for you!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Now that's what I'm talking about! I love bad boys!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And you know what? They totally make the best summer flings!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Didn't your last summer fling go to jail for arson?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay, first of all, T-Bone was totally framed...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And second of all, so what? We had a great time! I told you all about when we went to the amusement park, right?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Only, like, fifty times...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And what we did in the Hall of Mirrors...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Trust me, I'll never forget!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, there you go! The point is, you need to get out there and have a good time...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: With an arsonist?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: With someone who knows how to have fun! And I know just the guy!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Phil...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Goodbye.
And so, a few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can't believe it! What a jerk! What a sleaze! What a scumbag!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The nerve of that guy! How dare he break up with you?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Haven't you broken up with tons of guys?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well... Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But that was because they cheated on me, or because they forgot my birthday, or because they had stupid hair! `Not` when things were going just great!
nodes.text_bbcode: But that was because they cheated on me, or because they forgot my birthday, or because they had stupid hair! [color=#3b78e2][i]Not[/i][/color] when things were going just great!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's okay. You don't have to be mad about it. I probably could use some time to think...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh, no. No, you don't. We still have two weeks left of summer, and you are `not` spending it listening to depressing music and writing sappy poems!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, no. No, you don't. We still have two weeks left of summer, and you are [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] spending it listening to depressing music and writing sappy poems!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...You've already started writing, haven't you?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You want to see one? It's called 'Tears in the Rain'...
Nicole lunges forward and slaps the notebook out of Mallika's hands.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: This is summer break, and summer break is for messing around, meeting guys, and having flings... Not writing poetry!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: A summer fling? You think that'll just fix everything?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Look, I know you feel like you're out of the game... But trust me, a fling would turn this whole thing around!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You really think so? Are you sure you're not just trying to live vicariously through me because you can't have a fling anymore, now that you've got a boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Honestly, it's either that or cheating on him.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Now then... What kind of guy do you want to meet?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, I guess I'd like a guy that's...

nodes.prompt: I guess I'd like a guy that's...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I guess I'd like a guy that's...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I get it. You think we're stuck in a routine...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But I can spice it up! I can be more exciting! Whatever you want, Phil, I can do it, I swear!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You want me to be more outgoing, I'll be more outgoing! You want me to pay more attention, I'll pay more attention!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You don't understand. I don't `want` you to change. You're wonderful the way you are.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't understand. I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] you to change. You're wonderful the way you are.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: But I need to explore. I need to try new things. And I just feel like we've driven our relationship into a rut.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It's not that there's something wrong with you, I swear. It's that there's something wrong with `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not that there's something wrong with you, I swear. It's that there's something wrong with [color=#e23b3b][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I know what you're upset about, and I've been feeling it too.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But we can fix this! We can go on more dates! We can go on a road trip! We don't ever have to watch TV again!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I've... I've thought about that. I've thought that maybe we should get out more. Maybe we should make an effort to have more fun.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: But we haven't done any of those things, Mallika, and if we have to force ourselves to have fun, then there's something wrong with `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But we haven't done any of those things, Mallika, and if we have to force ourselves to have fun, then there's something wrong with [color=#e23b3b][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: If we're not happy being ourselves, then I just don't think we're right for each other.

nodes.title: Summer Fling
nodes.subtitle: Can you fix a broken heart?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You want to just abandon Skazz?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sure he'll be fine... He seems pretty resourceful.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: He once got lost in his own garage.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well... I'm cold and tired, Spike. I just want to get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry you had a bad day, but Skazz could be seriously hurt! I've got to go make sure he's okay.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: My bike tracks should be pretty easy to follow, and they lead right out of the park. If you follow them, you'll be just fine.
Suddenly, you hear Skazz's shrill voice shriek from far away!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaaaieeeeee! My leg! Something touched my leg!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh, it's just a raccoon.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaaieeeeeee! Raccoon!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, that's my cue. If you'll excuse me...
Spike pushes past Mallika and bikes off.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Maybe I should have helped him...
Mallika heads home alone, making her way out of the woods. Occasionally, she hears a scream in the distance.
The next day...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, no, you stay here... I'll go find him on my own.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, no, I'll go with you. The last thing I'd want is for you to get lost in the woods too...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Besides, I kind of owe it to you. If I'd listened to your advice, we wouldn't be here in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: In that case, thanks for the help! I appreciate it.
Mallika and Spike walk deeper into the woods, looking for any sign of Skazz...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Shhh! Did you hear that?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Huh?
Suddenly, Skazz comes barreling out of some bushes.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Aaaaaaiiiiiieeeeee! It's the Wild Woodsman who haunts these woods! Please don't kill me!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Owwww!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: There you are!
The three of them make it out of the woods, with Skazz trembling the entire way...
The next day...
Mallika boldly leads the way, pushing through the trees and bushes!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Here's where there used to be a trail... Here are some footprints...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I think I see a light in the distance!
Mallika rushes towards the light...
And finds Spike, waiting on his bicycle with a flashlight!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike! What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I found Skazz's map lying in the parking lot of the skate park, and I figured you'd probably need a hand!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Based on the dirt on your face and the twigs in your hair, it looks like I was right!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I have to admit, you really are... Thanks so much!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm sorry I didn't take your advice more seriously...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, it's okay. It's hard to imagine just how disastrous a date with Skazz can be...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Speaking of which, where is he?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Huh? He's right behind me...
Mallika turns around and sees only a long empty stretch of woods.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, come on! Where'd he run off to now?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Knowing Skazz, he's probably two miles away, knee-deep in a creek, with a squirrel stuck in his beanie...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, you know. The big kind. The one that's all black. With, uh, wheels. And windows.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And, uh, it can turn into a boat. And it drives itself and talks in a robot voice. You know. That one.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The `Super Mega Excelsior Omega?!` No way!
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]Super Mega Excelsior Omega?![/i][/color] No way!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I've always wanted to ride in one of those! There's only like, four in America!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, you must have some amazing connections! You'll have to hook me up some time!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, you know, sure! Any time!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What have I gotten myself into?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: To be totally honest, Tom, I've never really been in a limo before.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, you're more of a sports car girl? I dig that!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What do you drive? A Lamporgini? A Flairari? A Porksche?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, uh, I don't really drive any of those... I'm, um, not huge on sports cars?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't tell me you get around by private helicopter!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Actually, I sort of take the bus...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The what?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I think I misheard you. It sounded like you said 'the bus'.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha ha, I get it! You're joking! 'Take the bus'! Pffffft! How ridiculous! Ah ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Let's just get going...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The doorbell! That's got to be him! Go! Go!
Mallika heads downstairs...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey! Um, hello! Hi! Yo! Heya!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Could I be more awkward?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why, hello there. Nicole said you were cute... But I had no idea you'd be so beautiful!
Tom drops to one knee and kisses Mallika's hand!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Tee hee!
Mallika and Tom head outside... Where a giant stretch limo is waiting!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh my goodness!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You like it? I wanted to get the `Deluxe Premium Ultra` model, but they only had the `Elite Supreme Ultimate` in stock.
nodes.text_bbcode: You like it? I wanted to get the [color=#e23b3b][i]Deluxe Premium Ultra[/i][/color] model, but they only had the [color=#e23b3b][i]Elite Supreme Ultimate[/i][/color] in stock.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What kind of limo do you usually ride in?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I've never ever been in a limo!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I should...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Don't get me wrong, if I had to pick someone to have a fling with, Tom Prince would probably be at the top of the list...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But I'm telling you, I just need some time to think. I need to get over Phil.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Look, Phil is the past. Phil is history. Phil is Abe Lincoln. Phil is George Washington. Phil is Genghis Khan.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I think you're mixing metaphors...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The point is, Phil is over. And that means your top priority is making Phil jealous!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And what better way to do that than by dating Tom Prince?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's actually a pretty good point!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I know, right? All the Centerscore guys are totally jealous of Tom Prince, anyway... This will just drive Phil nuts!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: All right. You've convinced me. I'll do it... But only to make Phil jealous!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever helps you sleep at night.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What? What are you talking about?! That's ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: He's practically a celebrity! He's a world-class surfer! He's got his own brand of tanning oil!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure he went on a date with pop-star Gashley Simpson!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: First of all, it wasn't Gashley. It was her much less attractive sister, Stashley.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And second of all, so what? He might have money and experience, but he's still a local boy...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And that means he'll fall for a cute local girl!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I just don't feel like he's my kind of guy...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Look, I went through a lot of trouble to set this up.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And believe me, if I didn't have a boyfriend, I'd be first in line to go on this date!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: In fact, if you don't go, then I'm going to go in your place!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And then I'm going to cheat on my boyfriend, and we'll have to break up, and I'll be just as miserable as you!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Are you ready for that kind of guilt, Mallika? `Are you?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you ready for that kind of guilt, Mallika? [color=#3b78e2][i]Are you?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, no, I guess not. I'll go on this date, okay? But it's the last one.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: There you go!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's your idea of a summer fling?! `Skazz?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's your idea of a summer fling?! [color=#3b78e2][i]Skazz?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I mean, I don't really know the guy, but he seems nice enough...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: He got us lost in the woods! We could have died!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Eh. I've had worse.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Look, I'm glad you're trying to help. But please, for the love of all that is good in this world, don't set me up on any more dates!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay, okay, I won't. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...After tonight.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What do you mean, 'after tonight'?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay, please don't flip out... But I might've set you up on another date.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: He's really cute...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No way...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: He's really charming...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Absolutely not...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: He's `Tom Prince!`
nodes.text_bbcode: He's [color=#3b78e2][i]Tom Prince![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...Tom Prince?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: The Baron of the Beach? The Sultan of Sand? The coolest high schooler in the world? `That` Tom Prince?!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Baron of the Beach? The Sultan of Sand? The coolest high schooler in the world? [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] Tom Prince?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yes! Isn't that awesome?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: How do you even know Tom Prince? I mean, he goes to the Spartan Academy for Elite Boys! His dad practically owns this town!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And I thought he mostly dated girls from that snobby prep school, Monkeysorri...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh, our dads do business together, so I see him around sometimes... And when I described you to him, he said he was dying to meet you!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay, so I might've exaggerated a little and told him you were related to the King of Canada... But that doesn't mean he won't take you out!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...Canada doesn't have a king...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Details, details! Aren't you excited?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Excited? I've had a crush on Tom since fourth grade...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `Every` girl in town has a crush on Tom... And you get to go on a date with him!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Every[/i][/color] girl in town has a crush on Tom... And you get to go on a date with him!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Nicole, I... I can't do this!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why not?!

options.label: I'm not good enough for Tom!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You stay right here.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Nooooooo!
Mallika walks towards the light...
And finds Spike, sitting on his bike, holding a flashlight!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I found Skazz's map in the parking lot of the skate park, and I figured you'd probably need some help.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You figured right! Thanks so much!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm sorry I didn't pay more attention to your advice earlier...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ah, that's okay. Most girls don't realize just how dangerous a date with Skazz can be...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Speaking of, where is that guy?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Somewhere back there, hiding beneath a bush.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You sure we can find him?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Come on out, Skazz! It's me, the Wild Woodsman!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Aiiiiiiiiiieeeeeeeeeee!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yep, we'll be fine.
The next day...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ugh, fine. I'll stay with you.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh, thank you! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
A few minutes later, the light goes off.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: He's gone... We're safe...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You better hope that wasn't our rescue party.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ugh, there's no way we're going to find our way out at night... We'll just have to camp out until morning.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: It's... Pretty... Cold...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: We'll have to... Huddle together... For warmth...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Man... best date ever!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ugh...
The next morning, Mallika and Skazz find their way back easily...
And Mallika meets up with Nicole at her house!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure there's a trail here...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Or maybe it's here...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: A-ha! I found some footprints!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Those are `our` footprints! We've been walking in circles for an hour!
nodes.text_bbcode: Those are [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] footprints! We've been walking in circles for an hour!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess we really are lost...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You think so, too? Then we're lost! We're trapped! We're doomed!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now, don't panic... I'm sure we can figure our way out of this...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You don't understand! These woods are haunted! They say no one's ever survived 'til sunrise!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: They say the `Wild Woodsman` gets 'em! He lures them with his shiny light and chops them into little bits!
nodes.text_bbcode: They say the [color=#e23b3b][i]Wild Woodsman[/i][/color] gets 'em! He lures them with his shiny light and chops them into little bits!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, don't be ridiculous... There is no such thing as the Wild Woodsman...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, is that a flashing light?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaiiiiiiieeeee!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Please don't kill me, Wild Woodsman! Take her! Take her!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, for Pete's sake... I'm going to go check it out!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No! Please! Don't leave me!
Mallika and Skazz head down to the nearby pizza place, 'The Carnivore's Club'.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I love this place! They've got the best pepperoni specials... A killer sausage and onion pizza... And a great Meat-Lover's Combo!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Which one do you want to order?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, actually, I'm a vegetarian. Do they have any veggie pizzas?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Uhh... They've got the Garlic Chicken...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess I'll just have a salad...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: One Beef and Ham Salad! Gotcha!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sigh...
The date doesn't get much better...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I don't care what the principal says! If you touch my car, you're gonna get kicked in the ribs!
In fact, it seems to get worse...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And I just love the chapter where the author talks about his childhood, you know? It's so moving and lyrical...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, back up... What's a 'biography'?
And worse... And worse...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Boo hoo hoo... I just... SOB... I just feel so alone... I feel so alone...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: There, there... There, there...
And soon enough, it's time to head to the lake!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So, you're sure you know how to get to this spot?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Absolutely!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Well, I'm lost.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: How?! How can we be lost? We just got out here! Don't you have a map?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I thought I did... But I can't find it!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: My buddy said we were supposed to take a left at the tall brown tree... I thought we did that...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: There are a million tall brown trees! We're in a forest!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: ...Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Look, just let me handle it, okay? I'll find the way back to civilization...

rounds.subtitle: Find signs leading out of the woods!
Find signs leading out of the woods!
Lead Skazz out of the woods!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Can I have two samosas, an order of sashimi, and a side of stuffed grape leaves?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Of course! And may I say, that's an excellent order!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's okay, I suppose... Not that I'd expect `you` to know anything about fine cuisine!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay, I suppose... Not that I'd expect [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] to know anything about fine cuisine!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The nerve of some people!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I didn't mind...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, all I'm saying is, summer flings are a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But you shouldn't be looking for one unless it's something `you` really want... And stop me if I'm wrong, but that's not the vibe I'm getting.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you shouldn't be looking for one unless it's something [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] really want... And stop me if I'm wrong, but that's not the vibe I'm getting.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You know what? You're right. I haven't been doing what `I` want... I haven't been going after the guy that I like... And that's about to...
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what? You're right. I haven't been doing what [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want... I haven't been going after the guy that I like... And that's about to...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! What the heck are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What's going on here?! What are you two up to?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you accosting my date?! How dare you?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: He's not doing anything like that! We were just chatting!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know where you were brought up, but a lady does `not` chat with shady men in parking lots!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know where you were brought up, but a lady does [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] chat with shady men in parking lots!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey man, you're going to want to get out of her face... Like, right now.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ugh! Just forget it!
Mallika storms off, marching on a sand dune alongside the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Get back here! No one walks out on Tom Prince!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You listen right here. I went on a date last night where I got lost in the woods with a shoplifting, borderline-psychotic skater... And you know what?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It was fifty times better than this!
Tom lunges forward and grabs Mallika's arm!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How dare you talk to me like that?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, you did not just grab me!
Mallika jerks her arm away...
And shoves Tom over the side of the dune! He rolls down the whole way and splashes into the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...Oops.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This isn't over! This is just beginning! No one gets away with humiliating Tom Prince! No one!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Come on, that's nonsense. You always have a choice.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, you don't understand. Nicole is pretty forceful. When she's got her mind set on something, it happens.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, and you know why? Because she's surrounded herself with people who do whatever she tells them to.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's a little harsh.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry. I'm not trying to judge you or your friend. I'm just saying, you've got to accept responsibility for your actions.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's not like she's ever held a gun to your head, right?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, there was that time at the Civil War Reenactment Center...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But you're probably right. I didn't have to go along... I mean, I `knew` these dates weren't going to make me feel better.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you're probably right. I didn't have to go along... I mean, I [color=#3b78e2][i]knew[/i][/color] these dates weren't going to make me feel better.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess I was just hoping she was right.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You thought a date with Skazz was worth a shot?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, I didn't know it'd be with Skazz, okay?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I mean, I probably should have known better... But Nicole just knows so much more about dating than I do, I guess I kind of trusted her.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, I'm not judging. I'm all about giving new things a shot.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I got dumped last May, and I spent a week hanging out with the goth kids, moping around and wearing white make-up.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: How'd that go?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Terrible! My mom thought I had tuberculosis, and I had to stay overnight in the hospital!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! So, I guess things `could` be worse!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha ha! So, I guess things [color=#3b78e2][i]could[/i][/color] be worse!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, I wouldn't go that far! I'd rather have tuberculosis than be stuck having dinner with Tom Prince!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Good point!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ahem, sir... I was going to say, the restaurant would like to pay for your meal as an apology for my behavior.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No! They don't have to do that...
Spike shoots Mallika an intense look, and she holds her tongue.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, then! How very sensible of them! I'll have the Daily Special!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'll let the chef know right away.
Spike runs off.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And `that` right there is how you make your way in the world, Mallika. A little force, a little aggression, and a little bit of manipulation...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] right there is how you make your way in the world, Mallika. A little force, a little aggression, and a little bit of manipulation...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The best part is, I don't even like lobster!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I need to get away from this table... Before I stab him in the face with a fork!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I... I have to go... Wash my... Purse.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't take too long!
Mallika sneaks out the back to the parking lot... And finds Spike waiting for her!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, I can't talk too long... But thanks for helping me out.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sorry I had to be curt, but I kind of need this job... My mom's been out of work for a while, and she needs me to help with the bills.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Which, unfortunately, means I need to put up with the likes of Richie Rich back there.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I am so sorry, Spike... That guy is a nightmare!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Just finding out what a spoiled brat Tom Prince is, huh? Don't worry. You're not the first girl to go make that discovery...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Though you probably get points for making it this quickly!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ugh, I don't even know what I'm doing here!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'll admit, I'm a little curious... Not that many girls go from Skazz to Tom Prince in twenty-four hours!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's not even like that. It's my friend, Nicole... She keeps setting me up on these dates because I just got dumped a few days ago.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah? And why do you keep going on them?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.prompt: And why do you keep going on them?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: And why do you keep going on them?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He insulted me! That's what he did wrong!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: How, Tom? How did he insult you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I put in an order, and he's feeding me some nonsense about how they can't prepare it! A clear-cut insult!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And has it even occurred to you that they just might not have the ingredients? Like, actually?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No... No, I guess it hadn't.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, really? He's 'trying' to help?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let me tell you a little thing about 'trying', Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My father didn't 'try' to make millions of dollars. He just did. I didn't 'try' to win the gold medal in Olympic Surfing. I just did.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Losers try. Winners do.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And since I'm not sitting here staring at a broiled lobster stuffed with quail wings, I can safely assume that you're a loser!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um, I'll have three papparoons, a side of lokmodan, and a glass of creme bru bru.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Um, none of those are real foods. And I'm pretty sure you just insulted my mother in Persian.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...Papparoons aren't real?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Why don't I just bring you today's special? It's quite excellent.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks! That sounds great!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know what your job description is, but I don't think giving suggestions to my date is part of it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: My apologies, sir.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now then, I'd highly recommend you have the special! It's always excellent.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... Sure.
Mallika opens her menu.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So, um, what kind of food do they serve here?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, it's a global fusion place... They've got all kinds of stuff!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: This menu is huge!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I don't recognize any of these dishes!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hi, again! Can I start you off with any appetizers?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Actually, we're ready to order.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: We are?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: All right, Mallika... You can do this... Just act like you know what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Spartan Academy is extremely diverse!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We've got a prince from Saudi Arabia... The son of the ambassador to Ukraine... A math prodigy from China...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, so your school might be, like, ethnically diverse... But how about economically?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm not following.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Like, you know, not just rich kids?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Still not following.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Like, maybe the school could have some middle class students as well? Maybe even let some kids in on scholarship?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's like you're speaking another language... I have no idea what you're trying to say!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Argh, never mind!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Centerscore might not be the best school in the country... But at least the students aren't all stuck-up jerks!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That is so true. That is... So... True.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What? You agree with me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, totally. You have no idea how annoying some of the other guys at Spartan Academy are!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... That's not really what I...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Like, take my roommate, Kevin. He will not shut up about his family's mansion in Hawaii! Can you believe that?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess that would be annoying...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hawaii! Who cares about a mansion in Hawaii?! My dad owns ten mansions on Oahu alone!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Maybe we should just change the subject.
The limo drives Mallika and Tom to `The Oceanside Obelisk`, an extremely fancy restaurant on the beach!
nodes.text_bbcode: The limo drives Mallika and Tom to [b]The Oceanside Obelisk[/b], an extremely fancy restaurant on the beach!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, wow! This place is so nice!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Eh, it's okay. I've been to a lot better.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The court of the Prince of Omanco... Now, `that` was fancy!
nodes.text_bbcode: The court of the Prince of Omanco... Now, [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] was fancy!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yep, that sure is some court...
Just then, a waiter steps outside... And Mallika recognizes a familiar face!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hello, and welcome to the Oceanside Obelisk. I'll be your waiter tonight. May I escort you to your table?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey! It's that cute Spike guy! He works here?!
Spike shoots Mallika a wink, and Mallika smiles back.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, we'd like a table on the beach, please.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Actually, I'm afraid those are all occupied...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Then make them `unoccupied!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then make them [color=#e23b3b][i]unoccupied![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I can't believe it... But Tom Prince is kind of a jerk!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'll, uh, I'll do my best!
A few minutes later, thanks to a very accommodating elderly couple, Spike has set up a table for Mallika and Tom on the beach.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So... You go to Centerscore High, right?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yep! Do you know anyone there?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We occasionally play your basketball team at Spartan Academy... We slaughter them, of course!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Then again, most of our players go on to become professional athletes, so what do you expect, right?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um, I guess that's one way to look at it... Most of our jocks are just excited to play against you guys...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But that's ridiculous! Why play if you're not going to win? Those guys would never cut it at Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I don't know, Tom. I like Centerscore. I think it's probably better in some ways...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Really? Like what?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Are you out of your mind? His dad practically owns this town! This is going to cost me my job!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I didn't mean to get you in trouble...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Maybe you should have thought of that before throwing our richest customer into the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Is there anything I can do...?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You can get out of here before you cause any more trouble! Go!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Tom! Can I help you?! Is there anything I can do?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes! Get me out of here!
Mallika goes home, sad and alone...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hey! You!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Are you Mallika?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, then you, young lady, are in a lot of trouble!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What, did you think you could just throw Tom Prince in the ocean and get away with it? His uncle is the sheriff!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And if that weren't enough, we've got reports of a girl matching your description wandering around Centerscore National Park... `after closing hours!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if that weren't enough, we've got reports of a girl matching your description wandering around Centerscore National Park... [color=#e23b3b][i]after closing hours![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I was lost...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, believe me, you're about to find your way...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: To the county jail!
Officer Monte clamps his handcuffs on Mallika and leads her away.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I just wanted to have a summer fling...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You know who else just wanted to have a summer fling?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Al Capone! And look how that ended for him!
Yikes. Just yikes. You not only failed to have a summer fling, but you actually managed to get Mallika in trouble with the law!
This can't be the ending you want... So give it another shot and see if you can do a better job!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Nicole told me you'd be here, Mallika. I... I need to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Is this a bad time?
Mallika glances over the railing. Tom tries to climb back up the dune and makes it halfway before slipping and falling back down.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No. This is just fine.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I... I've missed you, Mallika. I've missed you more than I ever imagined.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Breaking up with you was a terrible mistake. I realize that now. And I am so, so sorry.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I was rash and impulsive and stupid. Mallika... Will you take me back?
Mallika glances back at the restaurant where Spike's manager is furiously chewing him out.
She watches him for just a minute and thinks about what could have been...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay... I'll take you back, Phil.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Oh, thank you! That is such a relief!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I got my boyfriend back... So why don't I feel happier about it?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: From now on, I promise, I'll be the best boyfriend ever! We're never going to be bored again!
One week later...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Next up... It's 'Unattractive Beatrice'!
You got Mallika back together with Phil... But that doesn't mean you made her happy!
Don't you feel like there's a better ending? Something more exciting? Something more fun?
Well... There is! So give it another shot!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What did you just do? Tell me you didn't just throw Tom Prince in the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...Um... Maybe?
You know your way around a summer fling... But you didn't quite nail that perfect game, and that means no bonus scene!
Give it another shot! You'll want to see this one!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Did you just throw Tom Prince in the ocean? Tell me you just threw Tom Prince in the ocean!
Down below, Tom tries to climb back up the dune. He makes it halfway before slipping and falling back down.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, waiter! You think this is funny? I'm telling your manager! You'll be fired in a heartbeat, you bum!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, Spike! I don't want you to lose your job because of me...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Are you kidding? That was totally worth it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Besides, this job's not really right for me anyway. I used to work down at the skate shop... They'll be glad to have me back!

nodes.speaker: Manager
nodes.text: Spike! What's going on over there?! Why aren't you working? Why is Tom Prince in the ocean?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That's my cue. Now get outta here! I don't want you to get caught up in this!
Mallika starts running down the dune...
And then turns around and kisses Spike!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You told me to do what `I` wanted, right? Well, that was it.
nodes.text_bbcode: You told me to do what [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] wanted, right? Well, that was it.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You mean it?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I do. I thought you were cute from the minute I met you... And you're about a thousand times more sweet and caring than Tom Prince would ever be!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I don't know if I'm ready for anything serious...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But I know I want to have fun, and I know I want to have fun `with you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I know I want to have fun, and I know I want to have fun [color=#3b78e2][i]with you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, in that case... Let's get out of here together!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sounds like a plan!
Spike grabs Mallika's hand, and the two of them race off together, grinning and laughing, before collapsing together in the sand.
Congratulations! You helped Mallika get through two terrible dates, set her up with a summer fling, and helped her get over Phil! You rock!
Be sure to check in next week for another exciting episode of 'Surviving High School'!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey! What's going on?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...Phil? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And what would you like to order, sir?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I suppose I'll have the broiled lobster stuffed with quail wings on a bed of caviar and foie gras.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm not sure that's on the menu... But I'll see what the chef can do!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, you'd better!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I just don't understand some people... Why would anyone ever want to work as a waiter?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um, I mean, he probably needs the money...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What, the pennies they pay these poor slobs? No one could ever get by on that kind of money!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I bet you couldn't even afford a third car!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's funny... I had a crush on Tom Prince for eight years...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And it only took me one date to realize that I can't stand him!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Um, excuse me, sir?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes? What is it?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We, um, don't have any of the things you ordered... It turns out we don't even have most of the necessary ingredients...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This is ridiculous! Do you know who I am? You will prepare my dish exactly as I've requested it...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Or you will face the full wrath of Thomas Quincy Prince!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm sorry, sir, but I can't...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That does it! Get me your manager at once!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Stop it, Tom! Leave him alone!
Mallika and Skazz head down to the nearby pizza place, 'The Carnivore's Club'.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I love this place! They've got the best pepperoni specials... A killer sausage and onion pizza... And a great Meat-Lover's Combo!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Which one do you want to order?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, actually, I'm a vegetarian. Do they have any veggie pizzas?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Uhh... They've got the Garlic Chicken...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess I'll just have a salad...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: One Beef and Ham Salad! Gotcha!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sigh...
The date doesn't get much better...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I don't care what the principal says! If you touch my car, you're gonna get kicked in the ribs!
In fact, it seems to get worse...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And I just love the chapter where the author talks about his childhood, you know? It's so moving and lyrical...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, back up... What's a 'biography'?
And worse... And worse...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Boo hoo hoo... I just... SOB... I just feel so alone... I feel so alone...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: There, there... There, there...
And soon enough, it's time to head to the lake!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So, you're sure you know how to get to this spot?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Absolutely!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Well, I'm lost.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: How?! How can we be lost? We just got out here! Don't you have a map?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I thought I did... But I can't find it!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: My buddy said we were supposed to take a left at the tall brown tree... I thought we did that...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: There are a million tall brown trees! We're in a forest!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: ...Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Look, just let me handle it, okay? I'll find the way back to civilization...

rounds.subtitle: Find signs leading out of the woods!
Find signs leading out of the woods!
Lead Skazz out of the woods!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey! What's going on?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...Phil? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What did you just do? Tell me you didn't just throw Tom Prince in the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...Um... Maybe?

nodes.title: But we haven't done any of those things, Mallika, and if we have to force ourselves to have fun, then there's something wrong with `us.`

nodes.text: A few weeks before the start of the current school year...
It's the end of summer break. Everyone is dreading going back to school... But for Mallika, the bad news is just beginning!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're breaking up with me?!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Mallika, you've got to understand! It's not that I don't care about you anymore... I just think we need to take a break!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Why? So you can date other girls?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, technically, yes.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: But it's not like that!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Mallika, we've been dating for four years. We've been together since middle school!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Don't you want to experience other things? Don't you feel too young to just be boxed in by a routine like this?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I don't feel boxed in by a routine...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Really? Can you remember what we did on our last date?
One week ago...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Next up... It's 'Dr. Domicile, M.D.'!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Or the date before that?
Two weeks ago...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Next up... It's 'Irritating Housewives'!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Or the date before that?
Three weeks ago...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Next up... It's 'America's Next Top Funeral Director'!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, okay, I get your point. But just because things have been boring lately doesn't mean we have to break up!

nodes.prompt: We don't have to break up!

nodes.text: The experts said it was impossible. The scientists said it couldn't be done. And despite all that... You just played a perfect game!
That deserves a bonus scene!
A few hours later... At Nicole's house...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry, Skazz, but you're just going to have to accept that Mallika doesn't want to go on another date with you!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'm telling you, it was true love! She just doesn't realize it yet! If you set us up on just one more date, I'm sure she'll fall for me!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Skazz, you got her lost in the woods! If I set you up on one more date, she'd probably get a restraining order!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I thought we had a good time...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Huh? The doorbell? Who could it be at this hour?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Maybe it's Mallika, and she wants another date, and she bought me a new skateboard!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Come in!
The door flies open, and a soaking wet Tom Prince storms in!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Tom! What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm here because that Mallika girl you set me up with threw me in the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She did `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: She did [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You set him up with Mallika?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I demand reimbursement! I demand an apology! I demand a towel and a blow dryer and some tanning spray!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: How could you, Nicole? You told me you'd help me get with her! You betrayed me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, you betrayed `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, you betrayed [color=#e23b3b][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey! Pay attention to me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, pay attention to me!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's going to be a long night...
Okay, so maybe things didn't work out so well for everyone... But in a way, those three deserve each other!
Congratulations again on a perfect game, and we'll see you in the next 'Surviving High School'!
